prompt: node.js cluster isMaster how determined condition
answer:
`cluster.isMaster` is determined by an environment variable: it is `true` when `process.env.NODE_WORKER_ID` is undefined, indicating the current process is the master rather than a worker.

[Source](https://millermedeiros.github.io/mdoc/examples/node_api/doc/cluster.html)
